text:
arjun: heads up — saw a spike of reconnects from EU edge around 11:04 UTC. some clients got duplicate stream events; billing shows +2 tokens for a handful of sessions.

liz: any sign in proxy logs?

matt: can you paste resume_id + socket snippet?

arjun: resume_id=rd_7a9f3b, logs: `resume accepted` then immediately `new connection accepted` with same resume_id. no intermediate reject.

sam: hmm, smells like a routing handoff during token rotation. we've hit a similar timing window before.

arjun: yeah — token rotated, client reconnected, and both new connections routed to different upstreams before either could claim the session lease.

liz: that would explain duplicates and double-billing. billing aggregates by connection_id; resume_id dedupe isn't in the billing pipeline.

matt: i'll attempt a deterministic repro on staging: force token rotate on active stream + trigger a route-table update.

ops-bot: canary deploy 2026-03-23T11:07 rolled to 10% EU-edge (sha:3bdf4a).

arjun: short-term mitigation: server-side billing dedupe based on resume_id + emit telemetry tag `resume_race:true` for traces that hit this path.

sam: also recommend a console banner to inform customers and reduce support noise.

liz: UX question — should per-session details surface "possible duplicate events"? want transparency but avoid alarming customers.

matt: propose two phases: 1) quick billing dedupe + telemetry; 2) medium-term: make routing claim atomic so only one upstream accepts the resume.

arjun: atomic claim affects edge LB and tenant shard registry — rollout risk is nontrivial. need canary and migration plan.

sam: lower-risk guard: when resume accepted, write a short-lived lock in route service (TTL=2s). subsequent accepts for same resume_id within TTL are rejected. low-effort and should drastically reduce the race window.

liz: +1. add a console feature flag to enable the TTL guard per-tenant during canary.

sre-team: please tune alerts to avoid noisy pages; suggest threshold >=5 dup resumes/min for now.

ops-bot: created INF-1249: "resume race — billing dedupe + short-lived lease guard" https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1249

arjun: matt — ping when you attach staging repro logs to the ticket. i'll start the billing dedupe patch and add the telemetry flag.

matt: repro confirmed on staging; attached logs to INF-1249. note: spike correlated with canary edge rollout.

sam: scheduling a 30m sync after lunch to decide rollout strategy for lease guard + console flag.

liz: agreed. also add console copy for banner: "Intermittent duplicate stream events may occur during routing handoffs; mitigations are rolling. See INF-1249 for details."

console-bot: draft banner saved to drafts > Notifications > Streaming Issues.

arjun: thanks — we'll iterate after the sync. :thumbsup:
